approvalScope: The verified 1.3.10 visual system, DCR-2026-001 Reports Intelligence hierarchy, DCR-2026-002 Management Command Center, DCR-2026-003 NVIDIA Hardware Search, DCR-2026-004 Label Content and Print Centering, and DCR-2026-005 Search Criteria Recovery are locked for future changes. Every visible control must remain connected to PostgreSQL-backed API behavior.
changeRule: A design change requires a Design Change Request approved by Gaurav Mehta. DCR-2026-001, DCR-2026-002, DCR-2026-003, DCR-2026-004, and DCR-2026-005 are the approved amendments to Design System v1.0.
releaseCondition: These artifacts and their automated gate must be committed before the next release candidate is packaged.
